population: B2B clean-train folds0-3=1421; four query-grouped CV folds using SHA256(example_id) modulo 4 within this population; fold4=611, B2B581, internal300, development, confirmation sealed
actions: STAY plus three distinct depth-10 stop-mask outcomes reachable by V8 Kendall<=2; choose the minimum-inversion, then lexicographically earliest relative-position order as canonical representative for each outcome
features: Only frozen V8 query and packet embeddings, changed packet embedding difference, query-times-difference, existing packet token-length difference, and changed V8 ranks; train-fold standardization only
labels: Set-valued strict Pareto positives: no anchor break, cumulative token <= V8, and anchor repair or token saving. Any anchor break or non-repair cost increase is negative. Repair with cost increase is ignored as incomparable. Duplicate nominal edit IDs are removed by stop-mask equivalence.
model: One linear scalar residual scorer shared across three non-STAY outcomes; STAY has fixed score zero; frozen V8 and Qwen3-4B, no capacity sweep

optimizer.loss: unweighted empirical pairwise logistic against STAY on labeled outcomes; neutral/incomparable masked

inference: Argmax among zero-score STAY and three edit scores; exact ties favor STAY; no tuned threshold
primary_gate: On concatenated query-held-out OOF rollouts, compare all five anchor counts, Complete, and mean normalized cumulative context to the same-query V8 depth10 baseline. A strict Pareto improvement requires no lower anchor or Complete count, no higher context cost, and at least one strict gain. Report repairs/breaks even when gate fails.
interpretation: This train-side OOF result is design validation, not independent confirmation or a deployable checkpoint. No 611/581/internal/development/confirmation read is authorized by this protocol.
